definitions.explanation: Indicates what constitutes the largest part or most significant aspect of something.

examples.japanese: {主|おも}に⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}ます→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{主|おも}に⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べています→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{主|おも}に⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}しています→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant mainly serves Japanese food.

notes:
{主|おも}に indicates that something is the main or primary element.

POSITION: Usually placed before the element being emphasized.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {主|おも}に + noun (mainly ~)
- {主|おも}に～て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (mainly doing ~)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧: main, principal (adjective form)
  - ⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧ (main reason)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {主|おも}に: mainly (what is primary)
- ⟦たいてい→たいてい：01129_taitei⟧: usually (frequency)
- ⟦だいたい→だいたい：00831_daitai⟧: mostly, approximately
